text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has claimed a magnificent 
victory over Biwa Hayahide...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide was amazed by her sister's 
run, and vowed to have a rematch with 
Narita Brian. Declaring that next time, it 
would be her showing her back.
